<h2 class="oneBlogTitle">
<a class="cpblog_post_titlelink" href="http://www.capcom-unity.com/dubindoh/blog/2019/10/09/mhw-iceborne-title-update-1101-ps4-11001-xbox-one-rajang-guiding-lands-layered-armor-and-more"><span>MHW: Iceborne Title Update 11.01 (PS4) / 11.0.0.1 (Xbox One) – Rajang, Guiding Lands, Layered Armor and more</span></a>
</h2>
<div class="oneBlogDateLine oneBlogSmallPrint" style="display: block;"><span id="blog_date_badge_year"></span><span id="blog_date_badge_month">Oct</span><span id="blog_date_badge_day">9</span></div>
<div class="cpblog_post_created_by">
<div class="cpblog_post_avatar_cropper"><img src="https://cdn.capcom-unity.com/capcom-unity.com/user/dubindoh/avatar.jpg?type=user&amp;ts=0830-1626"/></div>
By <a class="cpblog_post_created_by_link" href="http://www.capcom-unity.com/dubindoh"><span>Yuri Araujo</span></a>
</div>
<div class="oneBlogText fullTextContent">
<div class="cpblog_post_bodydiv" id="cpblog_post_1">
<p><a class="lb_pop_anchor" href="javascript:void(0)" title="Click for Image Viewer"><img src="https://cdn.capcom-unity.com/capcom-unity.com/user/dubindoh/iceborne/ab114bac5b382c92d1d02ba27c360c36.jpg?v=202200" style="width: 850px; height: auto;" width="600"/></a></p>
<p>Get ready, hunters! The indomitable Rajang has finally made its way to the New World, and this ruthless beast offers a challenge for even the most experienced hunters … so it’s not a fight that should be taken lightly. I’ll leave it to you to learn more as you set out to hunt it, but in the meantime, wanted to cover a couple of requirements and patch notes for <i>Monster Hunter World: Iceborne</i> version 11.01 (PS4) / 10.0.0.1 (Xbox One).</p>
<div class="cpblog_post_bodydiv_morediv"><a class="cpblog_btn_sm cpblog_post_bodydiv_morelink" href="http://www.capcom-unity.com/dubindoh/blog/2019/10/09/mhw-iceborne-title-update-1101-ps4-11001-xbox-one-rajang-guiding-lands-layered-armor-and-more"><span>More</span></a><div class="cpblog_spreader"></div></div>
</div>
<div class="oneBlogSmallPrint">
[ <a href="http://www.capcom-unity.com/dubindoh/blog/2019/10/09/mhw-iceborne-title-update-1101-ps4-11001-xbox-one-rajang-guiding-lands-layered-armor-and-more#comments">3 Comments</a> ]
<a href="http://www.capcom-unity.com/dubindoh/blog/2019/10/09/mhw-iceborne-title-update-1101-ps4-11001-xbox-one-rajang-guiding-lands-layered-armor-and-more#comments">Leave a Comment</a>
</div>

<div class="oneBlogPost">
<h2 class="oneBlogTitle">
<a class="cpblog_post_titlelink" href="http://www.capcom-unity.com/mobile_guy/blog/2019/10/04/us-named-as-first-official-national-team-for-intel-world-open"><span>U.S. NAMED AS FIRST OFFICIAL NATIONAL TEAM FOR INTEL WORLD OPEN</span></a>
</h2>
<div class="oneBlogDateLine oneBlogSmallPrint" style="display: block;"><span id="blog_date_badge_year"></span><span id="blog_date_badge_month">Oct</span><span id="blog_date_badge_day">4</span></div>
<div class="cpblog_post_created_by">
<div class="cpblog_post_avatar_cropper"><img src="https://cdn.capcom-unity.com/capcom-unity.com/user/mobile_guy/avatar.jpg?type=user&amp;ts=0122-1827"/></div>
By <a class="cpblog_post_created_by_link" href="http://www.capcom-unity.com/mobile_guy"><span>Mike</span></a>
</div>
<div class="oneBlogText fullTextContent">
<div class="cpblog_post_bodydiv" id="cpblog_post_2">
<p><a class="lb_pop_anchor" href="javascript:void(0)" title="Click for Image Viewer"><img src="https://cdn.capcom-unity.com/capcom-unity.com/user/mobile_guy/bc242c0ced47a654bc928fea0626bb58.jpg?v=196200" style="width: 850px; height: auto;" width="400"/></a></p>
<p><span>Today Intel and Capcom announced the the United States is one of the 12 national teams that will be competing in the Intel World Open featuring Street Fighter V. Qualifiers for the United States will run from 3/21 to 5/16.</span></p>
<div class="cpblog_post_bodydiv_morediv"><a class="cpblog_btn_sm cpblog_post_bodydiv_morelink" href="http://www.capcom-unity.com/mobile_guy/blog/2019/10/04/us-named-as-first-official-national-team-for-intel-world-open"><span>More</span></a><div class="cpblog_spreader"></div></div>
</div>
<div class="oneBlogSmallPrint">

</div>
<div class="oneBlogPost">
<h2 class="oneBlogTitle">
<a class="cpblog_post_titlelink" href="http://www.capcom-unity.com/capkel/blog/2019/09/30/capcom-at-nycc-2019"><span>Capcom at NYCC 2019</span></a>
</h2>
<div class="oneBlogDateLine oneBlogSmallPrint" style="display: block;"><span id="blog_date_badge_year"></span><span id="blog_date_badge_month">Sep</span><span id="blog_date_badge_day">30</span></div>
<div class="cpblog_post_created_by">
<div class="cpblog_post_avatar_cropper"><img src="https://cdn.capcom-unity.com/capcom-unity.com/user/capkel/avatar.jpg?type=user&amp;ts=0620-1016"/></div>
By <a class="cpblog_post_created_by_link" href="http://www.capcom-unity.com/capkel"><span>Kellen</span></a>
</div>

<p>Capcom will be at New York Comic Con 2019, and we’ll be bringing a whole lot with us! Read on for more details, including where to find the World of Capcom panel!</p>

</h2>

<p>Hello Hunters! The console release of <i>Iceborne</i> is upon us, so we wanted to go over some housekeeping items what you need to do to prepare for what’s coming in the next few days.</p>
<p>This blog will be a little on the dry side; trying to focus mainly on the logistical details of upgrading to the <i>Iceborne </i>expansion or <i>Monster Hunter World: Iceborne – Master Edition </i>which includes both the base game and the expansion.</p>

<p>We’re nearly there, hunters; the final stretch! We just dropped a “shocking” new trailer, our final Beta goes live tomorrow and the game launches in just a week, so this is as good a time as ever to look back and take a full count of every new, returning fan-favorite, Elder Dragon, subspecies, and variant monster we’ve revealed (thus far) for <i>Iceborne</i>.</p>

</h2>
<div class="oneBlogDateLine oneBlogSmallPrint" style="display: block;"><span id="blog_date_badge_year"></span><span id="blog_date_badge_month">Aug</span><span id="blog_date_badge_day">27</span></div>

<p><img height="285" src="http://static.capcom.com/unity/MM/MMZZXLC_Header.jpg" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; width: 850px; height: auto;" width="570"/></p>
<p>Six games, five heroes, and two series megamerge into one giant collection! Taking legendary Reploids into the far future, join Zero as he battles against the forces of Neo Arcadia, then witness the rise of a new generation looking to carve out their own story. <i>Mega Man Zero / ZX Legacy Collection </i>brings the intense action of <i>Mega Man Zero</i> through <i>Mega Man Zero 4</i> as well as <i>Mega Man ZX</i> and <i>Mega Man ZX</i> <i>Advent</i> to modern platforms beginning January 21, 2020!</p>

</h2>
<div class="oneBlogDateLine oneBlogSmallPrint" style="display: block;"><span id="blog_date_badge_year"></span><span id="blog_date_badge_month">Aug</span><span id="blog_date_badge_day">27</span></div>

<p><b><img height="276" src="https://cdn.capcom-unity.com/capcom-unity.com/user/capkel/f335f9ec7bad3512469617b8fe30e268.png?v=157320" style="width: 850px; height: auto;" width="570"/></b></p>
<p>Ready your Long Swords and your Z-Sabers - and be sure to pack a hot drink or two - Capcom will be at PAX West with <i>Monster Hunter World: Iceborne</i>, the just-announced <i>Mega Man Zero / ZX Legacy Collection</i>, and other fun activities to check out in Seattle! Make plans to stop by the Capcom booth (<b>#1102, Level 4</b>), and read on for more info on what we’ll be bringing this year, including a couple of signing sessions and a Monster Hunter Fan Event!</p>

<script>
//
// MouseTrap goodness for j/k Article Jumping
////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
$capcom(document).ready(function(){
var my_speed = 500;
var arts = $capcom(".oneBlogPost");
var idx = -1;
var next_key = 'j';
var prev_key = 'k';
var my_offset = 38;
var cur_pos = 0;
var near_art = 0;
function nearest_article() {
var i = 0;
cur_pos = $capcom(window).scrollTop();
if( cur_pos >= (($capcom(arts[arts.length-1]).offset().top) - (my_offset + 2)) ) {
return arts.length-1;
}
for (i = 1; i < arts.length; i++) {
// Add 2 to cur_pos to compensate for Firefox.
if (cur_pos+2 < (($capcom(arts[0]).offset().top) - my_offset)) {
return -1;
}
if((($capcom(arts[i-1]).offset().top-my_offset) <= cur_pos+2) && (($capcom(arts[i]).offset().top - my_offset) > cur_pos+2)) {
return i-1;
}
}
return i;
};
if( typeof Mousetrap != "undefined" ) {
// Bind configured hotkey to scroll window to the next article header
Mousetrap.bind(next_key, function() {
near_art = nearest_article();
idx = near_art+1;
if (idx >= arts.length) {
idx = arts.length-1;
}
$capcom(".current").removeClass("current");
$capcom(arts[idx]).addClass("current");
$capcom('html,body').animate({
scrollTop:($capcom(arts[idx]).offset().top - my_offset)
}, my_speed);
});
Mousetrap.bind(prev_key, function() {
near_art = nearest_article();
$capcom(".nearest").removeClass("nearest");
$capcom(arts[near_art]).addClass("nearest");
idx = near_art-1;
if (idx < 0) {
idx = 0;
}
$capcom(".current").removeClass("current");
$capcom(arts[idx]).addClass("current");
$capcom('html,body').animate({
scrollTop:($capcom(arts[idx]).offset().top - my_offset)
}, my_speed);
});
}
// Set up the date flags
$capcom('.oneBlogDateLine').each( function(){
$capcom(this).hide();
var mon_day = $capcom(this).text().replace(/\s+/g,' ').split(', ')[1].split(' ');
var year = $capcom(this).text().split(', ')[2].trim();
var curYear = new Date().getFullYear();
if(curYear == year){year="";}		
$capcom(this).html( '<span id="blog_date_badge_year">'+year+'</span><span id="blog_date_badge_month">'+mon_day[0].substring(0,3)+'</span><span id="blog_date_badge_day">'+mon_day[1]+'</span>');
$capcom(this).show();
});
// If we are not IE, do some fun stuff with image resizing
if( typeof document.CapcomBar.bdetect == 'object' && document.CapcomBar.bdetect.ie == false ) {
$capcom.expr[':'].inablog = function(elem,index,match) {

Object.keys = Object.keys || (function () {
    var hasOwnProperty = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty,
        hasDontEnumBug = !{toString:null}.propertyIsEnumerable("toString"),
        DontEnums = [
            'toString',
            'toLocaleString',
            'valueOf',
            'hasOwnProperty',
            'isPrototypeOf',
            'propertyIsEnumerable',
            'constructor'
        ],
        DontEnumsLength = DontEnums.length;
 
    return function (o) {
        if (typeof o != "object" && typeof o != "function" || o === null)
            throw new TypeError("Object.keys called on a non-object");
 
        var result = [];
        for (var name in o) {
            if (hasOwnProperty.call(o, name))
                result.push(name);
        }
 
        if (hasDontEnumBug) {
            for (var i = 0; i < DontEnumsLength; i++) {
                if (hasOwnProperty.call(o, DontEnums[i]))
                    result.push(DontEnums[i]);
            }
        }
 
        return result;
    };
})();
